title: PathoMap: a curated host-pathogen effector and intracellular survival-strategy dataset
description:
PathoMap is a curated dataset of bacterial pathogens, their secreted effector proteins, the host proteins they target, and the intracellular survival strategy each pathogen employs (escape, arrest, reroute, modified compartment, extracellular). It ships with reproducible analysis code covering network analysis, a Random Forest survival-strategy classifier, effector sequence feature extraction, and literature-linked records.
